$comment: Drain merge-queue safeguards: drain.waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue and drain.dequeueOnSendBack are booleans, both standard true. Inherit platform drain preferences unless deliberately overriding here. Environment overrides WE_DRAIN_WAIT_FOR_RED_TEAM_BEFORE_ENQUEUE and WE_DRAIN_DEQUEUE_ON_SEND_BACK accept true/false, 1/0, on/off. Effective values and sources are logged by both drain and red-team gate. Enqueue waits for the trusted post-accept red-team result comment on the exact live head when review:accepted or advisory:accepted owes that pass (unless either red-team kill switch is off). A confirmed send-back break also withholds enqueue until routed. Send-back removes queue membership, confirms isInMergeQueue=false, and comments with the reason. The red-team gate acts immediately; drain checks all live open rows before candidate filtering and its durable queue follow-ups as a backstop. Pending red-team reads retry after drain.redTeamPendingBackoffSec (standard 300 seconds), or when preread comments show a new comment. Pending state is durable and bound to the live head. After drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin (standard 45 minutes) with an accepted panel, return and log a health smell naming the PR; never waive admission. Both positive numeric settings use the drain cascade, log their sources, and accept WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_BACKOFF_SEC / WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_MAX_MIN overrides.
